body:
Two lunch boxes look identical. Before you open the one in your hand, ask:

哪个是我的？
Nǎge shì wǒ de?
Which one is mine?

哪个 (nǎge) asks you to pick one from a set.

You knock over the dominoes your friend spent an hour lining up. After apologizing, offer to fix it:

我帮你重新摆吧。
Wǒ bāng nǐ chóngxīn bǎi ba.
Let me help you set them up again.

重新 (chóngxīn) means to do something again from the start.
